steps.title: Is the kid clean?
steps.detail: Confirm the kid has been cleaned and dried after delivery.

steps.title: Iodine dipping of umbilical cord
steps.detail: Dip the kid's umbilical cord in iodine solution to prevent infection.

steps.title: Are the front teeth outside the lower gum?
steps.detail: Check the kid's mouth: the front teeth should be visible outside the lower gum.

steps.title: Does the kid have a suck reflex?
steps.detail: Place a clean finger in the kid's mouth and confirm it starts sucking.

steps.title: 1st Colostrum
steps.detail: Feed the first colostrum and record a video using the in-app camera.

steps.title: Take Weight of Kid
steps.detail: Weigh the kid and enter the exact weight in kilograms (kg).

steps.title: Is the kid standing?
steps.detail: One hour after birth, confirm the kid is standing on its own.

steps.title: Record pen
steps.detail: Record which pen this kid is in. This pen becomes the park's kid pen, so the next kid born here is placed there automatically.

steps.title: Colostrum
steps.detail: Feed colostrum at the {time} session on the {day_label}.

steps.title: Tag the kid
steps.detail: Scan or enter the permanent RFID, then record one tagging video. The same goat record is retained and its temporary identifier is retired.

steps.title: Are any babies still inside?
steps.detail: Check whether the mother is still in labour with another kid inside.

steps.title: Is the mother licking her babies?
steps.detail: Confirm the mother has accepted the kids and is licking them clean.

steps.title: Mother's Medicine
steps.detail:
Chocolate Injection at 1.5 ml SQ
Meloxicam Paracetamol at 4 ml IM
Exapar at 20 ml
Glucoboost at 100 ml mix with 150gms Concentrate

steps.title: ORS water
steps.detail: Give the mother ORS water to drink after delivery.

steps.title: Is the mother eating?
steps.detail: Confirm the mother has started eating after delivery.

steps.title: ORS water (2nd round)
steps.detail: Give the mother a second round of ORS water exactly 50 minutes after the first round was given.
